inventory_completion_explanation: The 46 atomic prior questions fix the inherited accountability surface. The current roadmap then contributes only nonduplicate carrier, relation, evidence-boundary and falsification obligations needed to make those questions testable. Their explicit union is the 72-row inventory below; the number is an output of the listed rows, not a target used to generate them.

obligations.statement: An observation act is one exact state-to-image Fold transition with its source, image and trace retained.
obligations.title: Observation act

obligations.statement: External observation is a record made about a carrier and cannot by itself establish that carrier's interior presence.
obligations.title: External observation

obligations.statement: Interior observation requires the observation image to re-enter the same organized process rather than remain only in an external record.
obligations.title: Interior observation

obligations.statement: Observer and observed are distinct held roles whose states may share an observation image without becoming one undifferentiated role.
obligations.title: Observer and observed distinction

obligations.statement: An observation class is the complete generated source fibre of one image, with every closed and retained predecessor distinction counted.
obligations.title: Observation equivalence class

obligations.statement: The least complete observational moment is one indivisible Fold transition; external duration belongs to its realizing carrier.
obligations.title: Atomic observational moment

obligations.statement: Physical measurement and interior observation may share Fold structure, but neither is substituted for the other and consciousness is not required for every measurement.
obligations.title: Measurement and consciousness boundary

obligations.statement: Cognitive access is the availability of retained content to another declared cognitive operation.
obligations.title: Cognitive access

obligations.statement: A report is an encoded output attributed to a source and is evidence of reporting, not an automatic identity with phenomenal presence.
obligations.title: Report

obligations.statement: Phenomenal presence is registered at the interior-observation boundary and remains distinct from access, report, behaviour and neural correlation.
obligations.title: Phenomenal presence

obligations.statement: Reportability requires both cognitive access and a retained expression route; absence of report alone does not decide presence.
obligations.title: Reportability

obligations.statement: A process may remain active while unavailable to the integrated access relation, so activity is not equated with consciousness.
obligations.title: Active unavailable processing

obligations.statement: Reports of altered experience are preserved as first-person observations while their ontological interpretation requires a separately derived and tested bridge.
obligations.title: Altered-state evidence boundary

obligations.statement: Binding begins with multiple retained content identities; erasing their differences is not unity.
obligations.title: Plural conscious contents

obligations.statement: Binding is a generated joint relation in which distinct contents participate in one successor while remaining reconstructible from held labels.
obligations.title: Binding relation

obligations.statement: Unity is one closed interior process over complete participating content, not a heap, synchrony measure or unlabelled aggregate.
obligations.title: Unity of experience

obligations.statement: Integration requires each participating process to enter the joint closure; a one-way influence does not establish one interior whole.
obligations.title: Integration boundary

obligations.statement: Synchrony may test a timing relation but does not alone prove binding unless joint compositional closure is independently shown.
obligations.title: Synchrony and binding distinction

obligations.statement: Fragmentation is the loss of joint closure while component processes and their distinct access records remain represented.
obligations.title: Fragmentation and divided access

obligations.statement: A perspective is the exact observation path available from one retained source position and is not an unlocated view from nowhere.
obligations.title: Perspective

obligations.statement: Interiority is the asymmetry between participating in a closed self-observation process and possessing an external description of it.
obligations.title: Interiority

obligations.statement: The subject carrier is the continuing integrated relation that holds a perspective while its content states change.
obligations.title: Subject carrier

obligations.statement: A self invariant is the unique admitted relation preserved across the declared self-observation trace, not an imported substance.
obligations.title: Self invariant

obligations.statement: First-person and third-person records may be paired but remain different evidence classes unless a bridge law is independently admitted.
obligations.title: First- and third-person evidence

obligations.statement: Phenomenal privacy follows where an external image closes a predecessor distinction that remains present to the participating interior trace.
obligations.title: Phenomenal privacy

obligations.statement: Self-observation is closed only when the generated observation image becomes an input to the same identified process.
obligations.title: Self-observation closure

obligations.statement: Introspection from the image alone cannot recover which generated predecessor label was closed by the act.
obligations.title: Introspection blind spot

obligations.statement: An exact self-history is reconstructible only to the extent that each closed fibre label was separately retained.
obligations.title: Self-history reconstruction

obligations.statement: Each unrecorded two-to-one self-observation closes one predecessor distinction; repeated loss is counted without negative information quantities.
obligations.title: Accumulated introspection loss

obligations.statement: A reported reason unsupported by the retained self-history is a generated completion, not recovered introspective evidence.
obligations.title: Confabulation boundary

obligations.statement: A process can have one generated successor while remaining unable to identify its unretained predecessor from the present image.
obligations.title: Determinism with self-opacity

obligations.statement: Memory requires a retained carrier relation linking the earlier content to its later availability.
obligations.title: Memory carrier

obligations.statement: Persistent memory requires a recurrent or actively renewed retained relation; a coincidentally equal later output is insufficient.
obligations.title: Memory persistence

obligations.statement: Recall is a traceable transformation from retained memory and cue to output, with reconstruction distinguished from verbatim storage.
obligations.title: Recall and reconstruction

obligations.statement: Temporal continuity is an unbroken generated predecessor-successor chain, not an assumed continuum between observations.
obligations.title: Temporal continuity

obligations.statement: Identity continuity requires both lawful lineage and the retained subject invariant; structural similarity without lineage does not establish numerical identity.
obligations.title: Identity continuity

obligations.statement: Cessation records the end of the integrated conscious organization while separately accounting for components, retained records and foundational forms.
obligations.title: Cessation of a conscious organization

obligations.statement: A self representation is an internal encoding of the process and is never silently equated with the entire represented process.
obligations.title: Self representation

obligations.statement: Self application feeds an admitted self-model output into the same declared operation while retaining binding and substitution provenance.
obligations.title: Self application

obligations.statement: The generated lower self-fibre reaches the binding image and then unison in two nonidentity acts; further application is identity.
obligations.title: Finite self-model depth

obligations.statement: A finite system may simulate a declared submodel of itself but cannot contain a simultaneous complete extra copy without additional carrier resources.
obligations.title: Self-simulation boundary

obligations.statement: A self-verification record closes only its declared finite trace and cannot erase the observer and premise distinctions needed to certify it.
obligations.title: Self-verification limit

obligations.statement: Attention is a retained selection within available content, not the annihilation of unattended alternatives.
obligations.title: Attention

obligations.statement: Focus is the continued selection of one content path across a declared sequence while background support remains recorded.
obligations.title: Attentional focus

obligations.statement: Content is cognitively available only to the operations that can lawfully query and use its retained representation.
obligations.title: Cognitive availability

obligations.statement: Attentional capacity is a finite support boundary measured with every selected, missed and competing content retained.
obligations.title: Attentional capacity

obligations.statement: An attentional switch is an ordered change of the held selection label with transition costs and failures preserved as observations.
obligations.title: Attentional switching

obligations.statement: A cognitive representation is a retained carrier-to-content relation whose encoding loss and lawful uses are explicit.
obligations.title: Cognitive representation

obligations.statement: Intentional relation requires a trace connecting representation to its referent class and retains misrepresentation as an adverse case.
obligations.title: Intentional relation

obligations.statement: Cognitive inference is a traceable transformation from retained premises to a conclusion under a declared rule.
obligations.title: Cognitive inference

obligations.statement: Prediction is a sealed present representation generated before its later observation and cannot be rewritten by the outcome.
obligations.title: Prediction and anticipation

obligations.statement: Expectation may lawfully participate in cognition and experienced response while remaining distinct from the later observation and clinical causal comparison.
obligations.title: Expectation

obligations.statement: Agency is an internally represented state-to-action process; the exact Fold model supplies no ungenerated successor while preserving the actor's informational self-opacity.
obligations.title: Determined agency boundary

obligations.statement: A realization carrier must physically or computationally instantiate every required conscious-process relation rather than merely describe it.
obligations.title: Consciousness realization carrier

obligations.statement: The foundational structural criterion requires dual self-relation, image re-entry, complete integration and interior closure; output resemblance is insufficient.
obligations.title: Consciousness structural criterion

obligations.statement: A consciousness law is substrate-independent only across carriers with a complete relation- and causality-preserving realization map.
obligations.title: Substrate independence

obligations.statement: A purely feed-forward transformation lacks image re-entry into the same process and therefore does not satisfy the foundational self-observation criterion.
obligations.title: Feed-forward boundary

obligations.statement: Realizations are structurally equivalent only when their relevant states, transitions, roles, integration and evidence boundaries correspond bidirectionally.
obligations.title: Realization equivalence

obligations.statement: An artificial consciousness claim requires auditable realization of the structural criterion plus purpose-matched bridge evidence; fluent language or confidence cannot select the verdict.
obligations.title: Artificial consciousness evidence boundary

obligations.statement: A qualitative distinction is a reproducible within-subject discrimination between interior contents with stimulus and report provenance retained.
obligations.title: Qualitative distinction

obligations.statement: Qualitative identity is a retained within-subject reidentification relation and is not reducible to a shared public word.
obligations.title: Qualitative identity

obligations.statement: Qualitative similarity is a finite comparison relation that preserves identity, difference and ordering rather than collapsing them into one metric.
obligations.title: Qualitative similarity

obligations.statement: Qualia resonance is stable reidentification of a held qualitative label across a complete recurrent interior support, tested against perturbation and changed-label controls.
obligations.title: Qualia resonance

obligations.statement: Qualia recurrence requires a later interior instance to re-enter the same retained qualitative identity class after an explicit intervening trace.
obligations.title: Qualia recurrence

obligations.statement: Qualia composition retains distinct component identities while generating one joint interior content; neither co-report nor synchrony alone establishes it.
obligations.title: Qualia composition

obligations.statement: Cross-modal qualitative binding is a joint interior composition whose distinct source modalities and qualitative identities remain traceable.
obligations.title: Cross-modal qualitative binding

obligations.statement: A physically classified red stimulus and the experienced quality remain distinct records connected only by a tested presentation-and-report bridge.
obligations.title: Red stimulus and experience boundary

obligations.statement: Red qualitative identity is the within-subject reidentification of a specific quality across instances, not the public token 'red'.
obligations.title: Red qualitative identity

obligations.statement: The red-of-red is the self-observed reidentification of the red qualitative carrier across complete recurrence, retaining the difference between the quality and a report about it.
obligations.title: The red-of-red self-reidentification

obligations.statement: The least registered three-position qualitative support is the exact one-seventh, two-sevenths, four-sevenths recurrence whose parts compose to the One; empirical evidence tests whether red identity is retained across the cycle.
obligations.title: Red recurrence

obligations.statement: The red-of-red test preserves matched, mismatched, absent and uncertain rows and must reject a changed label, changed stimulus or report-only surrogate.
obligations.title: Red-of-red contrast controls

obligations.statement: Empirical closure of red-of-red is participant- and protocol-bound: public evidence may establish stable discrimination and reidentification without claiming direct third-person possession of another subject's quality.
obligations.title: Red-of-red empirical boundary

scope: Observation and interior observation; access, report and phenomenal presence; binding and unity; subject, perspective and interiority; introspection; memory and identity; finite self-models; attention; cognition; substrate realization; qualia; and the specific red-of-red result.
